Gunnison County Court (7th JD): Ashley M. Burgemeister resigned effective 2026-10-15 (7th JD release 2026-08-31); nominees published 2026-10-08, no appointee yet. Removed from roster.

Official coloradojudicial.gov county 'Judges and Staff' pages carry NO last-updated date; they were cross-checked against the Judge Appointments page (2025-2026 vacancy/appointment releases). Three lag errors found: David Prince (4th, retired 2026-06-01) and Michael McHenry (4th, retired 2026-10-01) were still listed (removed); Rachel Catt (2nd), Lara Nafziger (4th) and Kathleen Tierney (Arapahoe County Court) were appointed but not yet listed (added from press-release coverage, flagged in notes). Other lag errors of the same kind may exist for events not announced via the appointments page.

Judges with known pending departures are KEPT because they sit today: Mark Randall (Jefferson Cty, Dec 1 2026), Bonnie McLean (18th, Dec 1 2026), A. Bruce Jones (2nd, Jan 13 2027), A. Nathaniel Baca (6th, Jan 13 2027), Renee Doak (Weld Cty Court, Jan 13 2027). See notes.

District judges: source pages give the county only for some judges. Where the county field was blank, county is set only if the judge appears on exactly one county page of that district (flagged 'inferred'); otherwise county is null (district-wide). 'counties' field holds what the source lists. Multi-county districts: court_id is null for judges serving several counties.

Denver: district judges are listed on three branch pages (District, Juvenile, Probate); Denver Juvenile/Probate presiding judges are included as District Judges. Denver County Court judges taken from denvercountycourt.org (17 judges, magistrates excluded).

Water judges, magistrates, senior/retired judges excluded. Titles like 'County Court Judge, Magistrate' (Cynthia J Jones 5th, Jason T. Kelly 12th, James R. McDonald 7th, Chelsea W. Ryan 8th) are county judges who also act as magistrates; included, flagged. Tamara Sullivan (Costilla) also acts as Domestic Relations acting district judge.
Miriah Sandoval (6th JD pages) has no title on the branch page and appears to be a self-help coordinator; excluded.

Judges' individual bios were not fetched; names are as published on the listing pages (some middle initials vary between pages for the same judge, e.g. Laura C. Makar / Laura Makar - longest form kept).
